saw_lines: Drivers choose their setup once and stay for years, so the choice is made on trust before the first click.
So proof and a clear reason to act must sit in the first line, where drivers decide to keep reading.
Your 2 of 27 copy ads use claim words that limit reach, so swap them for what drivers noticed after joining Pick in their own words.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 13 Nov 2026
points: 2 of 27 ads use claim words like cure and guaranteed results, and those words limit reach. Drivers who see a promise they cannot check stop reading. Swap the claims for what drivers noticed after joining Pick.

None of your 30 live ads shows a proof number, so drivers have nothing concrete to trust. Your site shows a 4.9 rating that no ad uses. Put that rating on the creative and lead the next batch with it.
0 of 27 ads mention an offer or discount, so a new driver has no reason to act today. Add a join-by date to your existing bonus, in line one of three new ads, above the See more cut.
Your copy ads open with 14 different stories, and the money stress opener leads 4 of them. Keep the best stories and build the next batch from them, changing the proof and the closing line.
